name: everstate-capture
description: Capture verified project state into Everstate while you work so continuity survives AI limits and outages.
long_description: Everstate Capture is a local MCP desktop extension that forwards structured project-state updates to your locally installed Everstate runtime. It does not store raw full conversation transcripts by default. Configure one explicit project root per extension instance to enforce project isolation. The Everstate home can also be redirected for isolated acceptance testing.

everstate_mcp_command.title: Everstate MCP executable
everstate_mcp_command.description: Select the installed everstate-mcp executable. For the development checkout this is typically ~/Everstate/.venv/bin/everstate-mcp.

project_root.title: Project root
project_root.description: Select exactly one project directory. The Everstate MCP server will reject capture or status calls for every other project root.

everstate_home.title: Everstate home
everstate_home.description: Directory under which Everstate stores .everstate/everstate.db. Keep the default home for normal use, or choose an isolated directory for acceptance testing.

tools.name: everstate_capture
tools.description: Persist one minimal structured current-state fact for the configured project. Do not send secrets or raw full transcripts.

tools.name: everstate_status
tools.description: Read the canonical Everstate state for the configured project.
